text:
ops-ella: consoles reporting multiple dashboard tiles failing to load with 'Analytics API 500' starting ~09:08 UTC for acme-inc. Correlation id 0a1b2c3d. Impact: customer-facing dashboards blank or stuck. Any known incident? @sre-oncall :eyes:

sre-jordan: looking. Can you paste a minimal repro curl and any headers (auth/correlation id)? Also which dashboard/time range?

ops-ella: repro below (redacted token):
```bash
curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -H 'X-Correlation-ID: 0a1b2c3d' "https://analytics.internal/v1/query?start=2026-03-17T08:55:00Z&end=2026-03-17T09:05:00Z&panel=cpu"
```
Response: HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Body: {"error":"index lookup failed","code":"IDX_ERR","correlation":"0a1b2c3d"}

support-maya: I'm seeing a jump in 5xx rate for analytics-api in the last 15m (from ~0.3% to ~12%). Alerts fired: analytics-5xx-rate high. CPU and memory look normal. Noticed several auth refresh logs around 09:04-09:06.

eng-analytics: we did a config rollout at 09:04 that enabled the new token fallback handler (intended to gracefully handle expired service keys). Rolling now: analytics-service v2.14.7 (4/12 pods). @deploy-bot can you confirm rollout status?

deploy-bot: Released analytics-service v2.14.7 by eng-analytics at 2026-03-17T09:04:58Z. Rollout: 4/12 pods available, strategy=rolling.

sre-jordan: can someone hit a single pod directly to rule out the LB? ops-ella: tried pod analytics-7f9d8-3 and /healthz is 200 but query endpoint returns 500. Attached a short log tail from that pod: 
```
2026-03-17T09:06:12Z ERROR handler.go:142 handleQuery error="nil pointer deref" req_id=0a1b2c3d
2026-03-17T09:06:12Z WARN auth.go:87 token_refresh failed service=console reason="no valid key found"
2026-03-17T09:06:12Z ERROR indexer.go:314 indexLookup failed idx=events shard=12 err="index missing segment"
```

eng-analytics: that auth log stands out — looks like the fallback path returned an empty key and then code didn't guard for nil. We're seeing the token lib return an empty set during rotation windows. We'll roll a hotfix to guard the nil.

sre-jordan: short mitigation: 1) route console->query-proxy (a thinner proxy that has a cached key) 2) clear prefix cache for problematic panels (kv-cache). Can support-maya patch the route?

support-maya: applied route change at 09:18 UTC (console now hitting query-proxy). Also hit POST /admin/cache/clear?key=panel:acme-inc at 09:20. Monitoring. :white_check_mark:

ops-ella: after reroute + cache clear, dashboards started to steadily recover; most tiles returned within ~3–5 minutes. A few long-range panels still show partial frames/timeouts.

eng-analytics: hotfix merged to master: guard token fallback and avoid nil deref. Will rollout remaining pods now (target 12/12). ETA ~10m.

sre-oncall: assigning incident id INC-20260317-01 and paging oncall for postmortem. Please attach logs/correlation ids for affected customers.

ops-ella: collecting customer correlation ids and will upload to the incident doc. Thanks all for quick mitigation. :pray: 

sre-jordan: followup actions: (1) postmortem and timeline, (2) add defensive unit test + integration test for token rotation edge case, (3) add an alert for 'token-refresh empty-key' to catch earlier. Assigned to eng-analytics and infra.

eng-analytics: got it. Will push PR for test + alert rule today. Will update once rollout completes.

deploy-bot: Rollout completed: analytics-service v2.14.7 now at 12/12 pods available (2026-03-17T09:30:21Z).

ops-ella: confirmed dashboards look normal for acme-inc now. Closing for now — will reopen if we see regression.

support-maya: marking customer impacted and issuing credit in billing tool as per SLA.

sre-jordan: thanks everyone. Incident doc: /incidents/INC-20260317-01.
